description: Manually transcribed published aggregate statistics, not game-level microdata. Charts reproduce aggregates; no causal effects or significance tests are estimated.

supply.note: Follower gain is not wishlist gain; these are comparable rank positions, not a longitudinal panel of the same games. The source describes the position as a game in the top 10%.

february_2026_benchmark.note: URL retains a 2025 date; the current article explicitly uses February 2026 survey data. P30-P70 covers the middle 40% of observations, not a confidence interval. Self-selected survey, no population weighting.

june_2026_correlations.outcome: Wishlists gained during Steam Next Fest
june_2026_correlations.note: Published coefficients only. Raw paired observations, per-coefficient complete-case sample sizes, uncertainty intervals and tests of differences were not provided in the displayed table. Do not treat point differences as established significant effects.

june_2026_contingency.outcome: At least 3,000 wishlists gained during SNF
june_2026_contingency.note: Exact inequality labels retained from source; treatment of values exactly 2000 is unspecified. Cell counts sum to 119. The 1/1 cell cannot support a reliable population success probability.
